decisions.text: What-if: assume this vehicle left the scene. Tracking on every camera.
Steer him to the primary road: only 3 ways out, police can be there 31 s before him. Using 7 signals; 1 uncontrolled turn on the way. Model says 100% he goes that way.
P1 Women police station: sent to block the spot, in place by T+68 s.
P3 Police: sent to back-up at the spot, in place by T+76 s.
P5 Patrol 5: sent to cover a side road, in place by T+85 s.
Old Bombay Road: green only towards the motorway road, red on the other 1 exit. He doesn't wait, so he takes it.
Gachibowl Circle: green only towards Gachibowl Circle, red on the other 1 exit. He doesn't wait, so he takes it.
He jumped the red and turned left onto Old Bombay Road, dodging the traffic held on the right. Off the plan.
The same spot still works: 3 ways out, 8 signals re-timed to bring him back, model says 100%.
P1 Women police station: stays on block the spot, in place by T+69 s.
P3 Police: stays on back-up at the spot, in place by T+82 s.
P5 Patrol 5: stays on cover a side road, in place by T+85 s.
Old Bombay Road: green only towards the primary road, red on the other 1 exit. He doesn't wait, so he takes it.
the junction: green only towards the primary road, red on the other 1 exit. He doesn't wait, so he takes it.
Stopped at the planned spot by Women police station, which was in place 50 s before he arrived.

nodes.label: Hatchback rolls into a parked red car

assumptions: The driver doesn't wait at a red and takes an open exit, leaning to his heading and the bigger road.
Every major junction is treated as having a controllable signal, though the map only records 17 real ones here.
Cameras sit at those junctions and always see him.
Traffic speeds and patrol positions are invented.
